title: Am I No Good? Towards Detecting Perceived Burdensomeness and Thwarted Belongingness from Suicide Notes
reasoning: The paper focuses on applying computational methods to detect psychological states from suicide notes and introduces a new dataset. While it touches upon ethical considerations regarding data usage and IRB approval, it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as its primary research component. The ethical aspect is related to responsible research conduct in a sensitive domain, not an inherent part of the model's or data's evaluation of ethics.
